官方资料核验于 2026-09-09。路线、停留时长与取舍为 BAYLINK 编: Official sources checked September 9, 2026. Routes, suggested durations and priorities are BAYLINK editorial recommendations. Recheck opening, prices, schedules and temporary restrictions before leaving. Photos are reference images with their capture years noted.
金门大桥半日：桥上看结构，Fort Point 看尺度，Crissy Field: A Golden Gate Bridge half-day: bridge details, Fort Point and the Crissy Field shoreline
把三个视角串起来，不必为了打卡走完整座桥: Three perspectives, without having to cross the entire bridge
从南端 Welcome Center 开始，选择短程上桥或桥下海岸线，分清人行道: Start at the south-side Welcome Center and choose a short bridge walk or the shoreline below. Understand sidewalk access, Fort Point opening and parking costs, with room for wind and slopes.
Golden Gate：桥上步行与骑行规则: Golden Gate: pedestrian and bicycle access
核对东侧人行道、季节门禁、施工通知和宠物限制。: Check the east sidewalk, seasonal gates, construction notices and pet restrictions.
确认城堡免费入场，其他消费另计。: Confirm free fort admission; other spending is separate.
核对季节开放、天气与室内犬只规则。: Check seasonal opening, weather and indoor dog rules.
查看海岸步道、公交、东海滩与 West Bluff 停车差异。: Review shoreline paths, transit and the different parking arrangements at East Beach and West Bluff.
第一次到金门大桥，最值得安排的是视角变化：桥上看钢缆和车流，桥下体会 Fort: For a first visit, change your viewpoint: cables and traffic from the bridge, the scale of the span above Fort Point, then a broader bay view from Crissy Field. Allow 3–4 hours for walking and breaks as an editorial suggestion, not an official tour duration. This does not include a cross-bay drive or a walk to Sausalito.
先选上桥，还是留在海岸: Choose the bridge or the shoreline first
步行游客只能使用面向旧金山市区的东侧人行道。桥上门禁随季节变化，施工还可能提前关: Pedestrians may use only the east sidewalk, facing San Francisco. Gates follow seasonal hours and construction can bring earlier closures; sunset is not an access schedule. Make a short out-and-back from the south end, turning around sooner in strong wind or crowds. Pet dogs, skateboards and electric scooters are not allowed on the bridge sidewalks, so plan for the whole group before arrival.
免费与付费分开算: Separate free access from extra costs
步行看桥、Crissy Field 公共海岸散步与 Fort Point 入场可: A bridge walk, the public Crissy Field shoreline and Fort Point admission can be free. Entering the fort still depends on its opening days. Transit, parking, rentals and food are separate costs. East Beach and West Bluff have different parking arrangements; one free lot does not make all shoreline parking free.
一条可以缩短的半日线: A half-day route you can shorten
南端集合，海岸收尾: Meet at the south end, finish on the shoreline
按现场开放的正式步道连接各点，桥面与海岸有高差。使用轮椅、推车或不想爬坡，可只选: Use open, designated paths between stops; the bridge and shoreline are at different elevations. With a wheelchair or stroller, or to avoid hills, choose just the lower shoreline segment. Map buttons locate stops and do not verify an accessible route.
先看现场通行告示，决定是否短程上桥并原路返回。: Check access notices, then decide whether to take a short bridge walk and return.
按正式路牌下到桥下；未开放时看外观，不绕过门禁。: Follow designated signs down below the bridge. If the fort is closed, view the exterior without bypassing gates.
沿岸向东走，找开放休息点；海浪和风大时不贴水边。: Walk east along the shore and stop at an open resting area; keep back from the water in waves or strong wind.
按体力决定走到这里或提前结束，先确认返程上车点。: Continue here only if comfortable, or finish earlier. Confirm your return pickup or transit stop.
让照片有变化，也给同行者留空间: Vary your photos and leave room for others
桥上的近景和桥下的全景不必都拍很久。先在宽敞位置停稳，再取景；不要在人行道中央摆: You do not need a long photo stop at every viewpoint. Stop in a spacious spot before composing a shot; avoid tripods in the middle of the sidewalk or walking backward for photos. If fog hides the towers, look at bridge and fort details instead of delaying your return for a clear-sky image. Make room for runners and cyclists after group photos.
带防风外层、饮水和方便行走的鞋；桥上体感可能比市区冷。: Bring a wind layer, water and walking shoes; the bridge can feel colder than downtown.
出发前同时查桥上施工与 Fort Point 开放，二者不是同一套时间。: Check bridge construction and Fort Point opening separately before leaving.
自驾先保存停车点，单向海岸路线还要安排如何回到车旁。: Save your parking location and plan how to return to your car after a one-way shoreline walk.
带狗只安排允许犬只的地面区域，城堡室内和桥面限制另查。: With a dog, choose permitted ground-level areas and check the separate fort and bridge restrictions.
